items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And she was born -- my mother was born in Poland and came here as a baby.

ctx.x: And she was born -- my mother was born in Poland and came here as a baby. And this is something that the people in Poland are much aware of, and it makes her a very warm kind of situation.
I see. That's why there's interest and reception for you over there.
